{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
control_moderate = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'control') & (trial_df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check if any variables are confounded across arms or severity
# Cross-tabulate arm and severity to check balance
print("Cross-tabulation of arm and severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['severity']))

# Check if age, sex, or site are balanced across control/moderate
print("\nCross-tabulation of control/moderate with age (median):")
print(control_moderate['age'].describe())

# Check sex distribution
print("\nSex distribution in control/moderate:")
print(control_moderate['sex'].value_counts(normalize=True))

# Check site distribution
print("\nSite distribution in control/moderate:")
print(control_moderate['site'].value_counts(normalize=True))"}
